text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) has 
arrived. Her manager rushes to the waiting 
room to check in on Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her manager insisted she should quit 
running if she couldn't run with charm. 
Those words only spurred Gold City on even 
more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the race, Tamamo Cross didn't spare 
Gold City a single glance. Even so, Gold 
City stoked her fighting spirit, vowing 
never to lose.
